description:
Citations. mode=citation (default): build one for a book, optionally a page and quoted text — Shamela's copy format, short inline, full with death year, or BibTeX/RIS. Call it whenever you attribute a quote; it needs only the catalogue, plus the installed text for a page's printed number. Read page_resolved, components.auto_numbered and notes[] before presenting.
mode=printed_page: map a printed citation («vol. 4, p. 405») to the page_ids carrying it — no arithmetic relates the two, and one printed page often spans several ids: read them all, in order, with shamela_read(unit='page'). Resolve the work with shamela_find(kind='work') first; holding a page_id already, skip this. Failures come back as `status`; citable:false = Shamela's own numbering. Error: BOOK_NOT_FOUND.

book_id.description: [mode=citation] The book id, from shamela_find(kind='book'), shamela_find(kind='work') or shamela_find(kind='name'). [mode=printed_page] The book. Resolve a cited title with shamela_find(kind='work') first — and note that different printings of one work paginate differently, so the book_id must be the printing the citation came from.

mode.description: Selects what the call does: citation | printed_page. Default citation.

page.description: The PRINTED page number as the citation gives it (e.g. 405). Example: {book_id:6910, part:'4', page:405}; {book_id:1681, part:'1', page:6}. (mode=printed_page only.)

page_id.description: Optional page_id. When omitted, the citation references the book without a specific page and page_resolved is null. A page id that is missing, has no printed number, or belongs to a book whose text is not installed here yields a book-level citation with page_resolved:false and a note. Example: {book_id:1681, page_id:10}, or with text:'<quoted passage>', style:'shamela'. (mode=citation only.)

part.description: The volume/part label as the book uses it, usually a bare number ('4'). Omit when the citation names no volume or the work is single-volume: the search then runs across every part and the response reports which parts matched, so an ambiguous page number is visible rather than silently resolved to the first volume. (mode=printed_page only.)

response_format.description: Format of the human-readable text: 'markdown' (default) for display; 'json' the same data as one JSON code block; 'none' only a one-line pointer, leaving structuredContent as the whole answer. structuredContent is always returned, so a caller that parses it should pass 'none': the character budget counts both channels, and the unread copy otherwise spends most of it. Requires the 'response_format.none' capability (see shamela_get_brief).

style.description: Citation style. 'shamela' replicates Shamela's UI copy-with-citation format (default). 'short' is a one-line inline reference. 'full' is the long form including author death year and book year, with notes listing missing fields (publisher/edition/etc are not in master.db). 'bibtex' and 'ris' are machine-readable exports for Zotero/EndNote/Mendeley (Western digits, Arabic UTF-8, stable cite key shamela<book_id>p<page_id>); they carry only fields master.db has, with the same missing-field notes[]. 'short' reads <author>، <book>، ص <page>. Every style but bibtex/ris uses Arabic-Indic digits. (mode=citation only.)

text.description:
Optional quoted text. Used by the 'shamela' style only, which then prints a two-line block: «<book>» (<part>/ <page>):
«<text>». Other styles ignore it. (mode=citation only.)

name: shamela_cite

available_parts.description: On part_not_found: the part labels the book uses. (mode=printed_page only.)

book_name.description: Catalogue title of the book (Arabic). (mode=printed_page only.)

citable.description: False when the numbers are Shamela's own, not a printed edition's. (mode=printed_page only.)

components.description: The parts the citation was built from. (mode=citation only.)

auto_numbered.description: True when page numbers are Shamela's own («بترقيم الشاملة آليا»), not a printed edition's: say so whenever you present the citation, never as a printed page.

formatted.description: The citation text in the requested style. (mode=citation only.)

matches.description: One row per page id. (mode=printed_page only.)

printed_page.description: Label as the page tools render it, e.g. '4/ 405'.

notes.description: [mode=citation] Missing citation fields and fallbacks; never fill them in. [mode=printed_page] Guidance on reading the result.

page_ids.description: Every page id carrying the printed page, in reading order; read them all. Shamela splits a long printed page across records, so one page routinely has several ids (part '1', page 6 of book 1681 = ids 9, 10, 11 in the fixture). (mode=printed_page only.)

page_range.description: On page_not_in_part: the printed range that exists in that part. (mode=printed_page only.)

page_resolved.description: True when the page and its printed number were found; false when the citation fell back to book level (see notes) and must not be presented as a page reference; null when no page_id was given. (mode=citation only.)

parts_matched.description: Distinct parts matched; more than one means the number is ambiguous across volumes. (mode=printed_page only.)

requested_part.description: Part label requested; null when omitted. (mode=printed_page only.)

status.description: 'ok', 'book_not_downloaded', 'no_printed_pagination' (Shamela paginates this entry itself: no printed page exists), 'part_not_found' or 'page_not_in_part'. (mode=printed_page only.)

title: Format a citation or resolve a printed page
